_comment: Hand fixes for TV shows, applied by scripts/fetch-tv.mjs (via lib/famous-topic.mjs). Keys are generated item ids: any TopicItem field can be overridden, "aliases" are ADDED to the generated ones, "exclude": true drops the item. "_add" lists shows the source misses (e.g. no date on Wikidata); they are always kept. node scripts/verify-tv.mjs suggests entries for any checklist failure.
